themes.summary: Many buyers say InPrivy is simple, fast, and reliably handles secure password and file sharing with branding and expiry controls.

hits.quote: here is the protected information you need, through a controlled sharing surface.
Attachments in email never expire and sit around in inboxes, waiting for a mail admin or the mail hoster to look into your information.
Does exactly what it says.
I had my new InPrivy purchased, setup and sending in under 15 minutes.
Fantastic white label password sharing tool.
InPrivy removes all of this, and provides a decent audit trail so you can see whether secrets have been viewed etc.
I use this app daily to send, and receive secure documents, and passwords to clients and business partners.
preparing the shared information is totally straight forward, recipients understand the use of InPrivy intuitively
The link can only be opened once and then it stops working.
One of my favorite features is the notification I receive when the recipient opens the shared item
securely sharing passwords and sensitive data via a one-time link that can be revoked
No glitches, works as expected and overall an awesome deal.
I love the expiration part and folders for different clients.
not only sending secrets to customers, but also setting up a CNAME so that customers can send encrypted content to us via a website
Very intuitive to use and reliable features.

themes.summary: Several buyers call the lifetime deal a no-brainer and well worth the price for the security and professionalism it adds.

hits.quote: this InPrivy lifetime deal is a no-brainer.
Well worth the purchase price.
to solve this problem for $39 is in the Shut Up and Just Take My Money category.
You deliver so much value with every single product that I genuinely feel like I’m stealing from you!

themes.summary: Several buyers request missing capabilities like reverse file collection, API/webhooks, no-expiration option, and post-creation editing.

hits.quote: there is no way to do this in reverse.
Right now, you have to select a far-future date (e.g., 100 years) for long-lived secrets.
an API/webhook path to create and expire shares, retrieve current state, and read view/access events would make it much easier

themes.summary: Two buyers report bugs that prevent creating, accessing, or emailing secrets.

hits.quote: bugs in the program that prevent it from working (email and so on)
once it I don't see a button or anything allowing me to access the first test secret I created.

themes.summary: One buyer praises exceptionally fast weekend support for a licensing mistake.

hits.quote: I received a response and solution within minutes.
